english: I'm going to make VOLBEAT super\nstrong from this moment on!\pI hope you do the same with PLUSLE!
dutch: Vanaf nu maak ik VOLBEAT super\nsterk!\pHoud jij PLUSLE ook sterk!

english: Trading POKéMON with others…\pIt's as if you're trading your own\nmemories with other people.
dutch: POKéMON ruilen met anderen…\pHet is alsof je je eigen\nherinneringen ruilt.
